dataList.content:
The child flinched as Heathcliff took a step toward them, and backed away.
希斯克利夫靠近时，那孩子瑟缩了一下，向后退去。

And when they realized there was nowhere to go, they shrank to the ground and began to tremble in... what appeared to be fear.
意识到已经无处可躲后，它缩成一团……似乎因为害怕颤抖了起来。

... What're you lookin' at me like that for?
……你们看我干什么？
I— What? What? Seriously... 不是……怎么了！？喂……

Did I hit the kid? No! I ain't even done shite yet! I just said "Oi," that's all I did!
我揍它了吗？还是干了什么啊？我只是走近和它打了声招呼而已！

Heathcliff, a degree of self-awareness of how one might appear to a child would be helpful.
希斯克利夫先生……看来您还不清楚自己给别人的印象。

That bluntness you often exhibit generally instills fear in the weak.
这种印象……很可能会使弱者心生恐惧。

You can't be serious. Bloody hell, get someone else from the restroom, then...! Can't help the way I look, yeah?
该死的……那你就从卫生间里带其他人来啊……！我这张脸就长这样，能有什么办法！？

I believe this not to be a matter of appearance but of bearing.
问题不在于长相，而在于态度。
